activity_summary: Under the Queen's line you noted Two Gentlemen on St Stephen's night and Errors on Innocents' Day, and you counted the coffer at twenty-four pound ten. You set down three winter marks: finish the comedy before Shrovetide, keep clear of tavern scores, carry silver home at Lent. Mistress Ansell dropped a pan below. You added a private line, that the year begins with demands from below.
